name: Uchumi Supermarkets Plc
source: Uchumi Supermarkets Plc audited annual report and financial statements, year ended 30 June 2025 (under Company Voluntary Arrangement), consolidated statement of profit or loss, page 40. Figures printed in KShs thousands; stored as absolute KES. | CRON 20261114: EPS row added from the printed earnings per share line, page 43. | 2026-11-15 verified against the issuer's own audited report (Uchumi Supermarkets Plc annual report and financial statements for the year ended 30 June 2025, consolidated statement of profit or loss, page 40 of the document): the statement runs Sales 123,025, cost of sales (93,006), gross profit 30,019, other income 68,634, expenses (91,094), profit from operating activities 7,559, provisions and write offs 1,129, profit before tax 8,688, income tax nil, profit for the year 8,688. There is no finance cost line at all because the Company Voluntary Arrangement froze creditor interest, so Net Finance Costs is correctly empty rather than missing. Figures confirmed: revenue less cost of sales equals the printed 30,019 and profit before tax less nil tax equals the printed 8,688.

rows.note: CRON 20261114: printed as Earnings /(Loss) per share (Basic and diluted) in the audited consolidated statement of profit or loss, Uchumi Supermarkets Plc, year ended 30 June 2025, page 43: KES 0.03 for FY2025 and KES 0.06 for FY2024. The issuer computes it on total comprehensive income per note 19 (9,969 and 21,960 Kshs 000 over 364,962,000 shares), which is the basis its own statement prints.
